@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+From: nicm <nicm>
+Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 14:33:55 +0000
+Subject: Do not check control subscriptions when client has no session
+
+If a control client's session is destroyed and no replacement is
+available, c->session becomes NULL. The subscription timer fires
+every second and multiple paths dereference c->session without a
+NULL check, crashing the server.
+
+Origin: backport, https://github.com/tmux/tmux/commit/881bec958e2fd9093ed2c8fd8f934196f6afa7da
+Bug-Ubuntu: https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/tmux/+bug/2172659
+---
+ control.c | 3 +++
+ 1 file changed, 3 insertions(+)
+
+diff --git a/control.c b/control.c
+index 79097fc..086a2bf 100644
+--- a/control.c
++++ b/control.c
+@@ -1047,6 +1047,9 @@ control_check_subs_timer(__unused int fd, __unused short events, void *data)
+ 	log_debug("%s: timer fired", __func__);
+ 	evtimer_add(&cs->subs_timer, &tv);
+ 
++	if (c->session == NULL)
++		return;
++
+ 	RB_FOREACH_SAFE(csub, control_subs, &cs->subs, csub1) {
+ 		switch (csub->type) {
+ 		case CONTROL_SUB_SESSION:
